name: aletheia-mcp
displayName: Aletheia Runtime Safety & Scope Creep Filter
description: Fast deterministic pre-execution filter for AI agent tool calls. Pattern-matches known scope-creep (S3) and prompt-injection (S2b) vectors (destructive shell/SQL, credential reads, SSRF, out-of-mandate writes) and blocks them in ~25 microseconds with no LLM in the hot path. A first-line pre-filter, not a sandbox or a formal guarantee.
author: Vikas Shivpuriya <vikas.ny30@gmail.com>
